chapter.heading: A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
When Jehovah
brought back those that returned to Zion,We were like unto them that dream.

Then was
our mouth filled with laughter,And our tongue with singing:Then said they among the nations,Jehovah hath done great things for them.

Jehovah hath
done great things for us,Whereof we are glad.

Turn again
our captivity, O Jehovah,As the streams in the South.

They that
sow in tears shall reap in joy.

He that
goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing,Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
